title_zh: 第 1 部分 — 公民、權利、責任（25 題）
qa: To whom do you swear allegiance in the Oath of Citizenship?
加拿大入籍誓詞中效忠的對象是？
King Charles the Third, King of Canada, his heirs and successors.
加拿大國王查理三世，及其繼承人與後嗣。
Which three Aboriginal peoples' treaty rights does the Oath specifically recognize?
入籍誓詞特別承認哪三類原住民條約權利？
First Nations, Inuit and Métis.
第一民族、因紐特人、梅蒂人。
What are the four fundamental freedoms in the Charter?
公民的 4 大基本自由依憲章是？
Freedom of conscience and religion; freedom of thought, belief, opinion and expression (including the press); freedom of peaceful assembly; freedom of association.
良知／宗教自由；思想、信仰、意見與表達自由（含新聞）；和平集會自由；結社自由。
What are the six responsibilities of citizenship?
公民的 6 大責任？
Obeying the law, taking responsibility for oneself and one's family, serving on a jury, voting in elections, helping others in the community, and protecting and enjoying our heritage and environment.
守法、照顧自己與家庭、擔任陪審員、投票、協助社區、保護加拿大遺產與環境。
What are Mobility Rights?
「Mobility Rights」指什麼？
The right to live and work anywhere in Canada, to enter and leave the country freely, and to apply for a passport.
在加拿大任意居住、工作、自由進出國境並申請護照的權利。
What right is habeas corpus?
「Habeas Corpus」是什麼權利？
The right to challenge unlawful detention by the state; it comes from English common law.
被拘留者可挑戰拘留合法性的權利；來自英國普通法。
Do citizens have a right not to work?
公民有沒有不工作的權利？
There is no such guarantee, but no one is forced into a particular job. Getting a job and working hard is described as a responsibility and a Canadian value.
沒有此項保障，但也不強迫做特定工作。找工作、努力工作被視為責任與加拿大價值。
Are men and women equal under Canadian law?
加拿大男女在法律上是否平等？
Yes.
是。
Is forced marriage a civil or a criminal matter in Canada?
強迫婚姻在加拿大是民事還是刑事？
Criminal — those guilty are severely punished under Canada's criminal laws.
刑事——犯者依加拿大刑法嚴懲。
What is Canada's most important legal document of 1982?
加拿大 1982 年的最重要法律文件是什麼？
The Canadian Charter of Rights and Freedoms, entrenched in the Constitution in 1982.
《加拿大權利與自由憲章》，1982 年寫入憲法。
In what year was Magna Carta signed in England?
Magna Carta 是哪一年的英國文件？
Is serving on a jury a right or a responsibility?
服務陪審團屬權利還是責任？
A responsibility — when called, you are legally required to serve.
責任——被傳喚時依法必須擔任。
Is voting a right or a responsibility?
投票屬權利還是責任？
Both — the right to vote comes with the responsibility to vote.
兩者皆是——投票權伴隨投票的責任。
Can permanent residents vote in federal elections?
永久居民可不可以投票？
No — only Canadian citizens aged 18 or older on the voters' list.
不可以——只有 18 歲以上且在選民名冊上的加拿大公民可以。
What are the three traditions that Canadian law comes from?
加拿大法律來自哪三大傳統？
The unwritten British constitution, English common law, and the civil code of France, plus laws passed by Parliament and the provinces.
英國不成文憲政、英國普通法、法國民法，加上國會與各省通過的法律。
What does the rule of law mean?
「Rule of Law」是什麼意思？
Both government and people are bound by the law; no person or group is above the law.
政府與人民都受法律約束，沒有人凌駕於法律之上。
Does freedom of expression include freedom of the press?
言論自由是否包含新聞自由？
Yes — freedom of thought, belief, opinion and expression includes freedom of speech and of the press.
是——表達自由包含言論自由與新聞自由。
Is multiculturalism a right or a responsibility?
多元文化遺產屬於權利還是責任？
A right — the Charter lists multiculturalism as a fundamental characteristic of Canadian heritage and identity.
權利——憲章把多元文化列為加拿大傳統與身分的基本特徵。
Is obeying the law a right or a responsibility?
守法屬於權利還是責任？
A responsibility.
責任。
Which of these may you NOT do: (A) choose your religion, (B) assemble publicly, (C) refuse to obey the law, (D) associate peacefully?
你不可以做以下哪一項：（A）信仰自選（B）公開集會（C）拒絕守法（D）和平結社
C — obeying the law is a responsibility of every citizen.
C——守法是每位公民的責任。
What is 'equality before the law' in Chinese?
「Equality before the law」中文是？
Everyone is equal before the law (法律之前人人平等).
法律之前人人平等。
What is one of the biggest differences between a citizen and a permanent resident?
公民與永久居民的最大差別之一是什麼？
Citizens can vote, run for office and hold a Canadian passport.
投票權、競選公職、持加拿大護照。
Is helping others in the community a responsibility of citizenship?
「協助社區」是公民責任嗎？
Yes — millions of volunteers help others without pay.
是——數百萬志工無償幫助他人。
Is protecting Canada's heritage and environment a responsibility or a right?
「保護加拿大遺產與環境」是責任還是權利？
A responsibility.
責任。
Which document does 'the Constitution' in the Oath include?
申請入籍時誓詞中說的「Constitution」包含哪一份文件？
The Canadian Charter of Rights and Freedoms, which recognizes and affirms Aboriginal and treaty rights.
《加拿大權利與自由憲章》，其中承認並確認原住民與條約權利。

title_en: Chapter 2 — Who We Are, Languages, Aboriginal Peoples (20)
title_zh: 第 2 部分 — 我們是誰、語言、原住民（20 題）
qa: Who are Canada's three founding peoples?
加拿大三大開國民族？
Aboriginal, French and British.
原住民、法裔、英裔。
What are the three groups of Aboriginal peoples and their share of the Aboriginal population?
原住民 3 大類別與占原住民人口比例？
First Nations about 65%, Métis 30%, Inuit 4%.
第一民族約 65%、梅蒂人 30%、因紐特人 4%。
Which Aboriginal people live in the Arctic?
哪一族原住民住在北極區？
The Inuit.
因紐特人。
Which Aboriginal people are of mixed Aboriginal and European ancestry?
哪一族原住民是歐裔與原住民混血？
The Métis.
梅蒂人。
What are the two official languages?
兩種官方語言？
English and French.
英語與法語。
In what year was the Official Languages Act passed?
官方語言法哪一年通過？
In what year did multiculturalism become official policy?
多元文化主義哪一年成為加拿大官方政策？
Which prime minister introduced multiculturalism?
推動多元文化主義的總理是？
Pierre Elliott Trudeau.
皮埃爾・艾略特・杜魯道（老杜魯道）。
What is the largest religious tradition in Canada?
加拿大最大宗教傳統是？
Christianity — Catholics are the largest group, followed by Protestants.
基督宗教——天主教最多，其次是新教。
What is Canada's population today?
加拿大目前人口大約多少？
About 40 million (the 2021 guide says about 34 million).
What are Canada's three largest metropolitan areas?
三大都會是？
Toronto, Montreal and Vancouver.
多倫多、蒙特婁、溫哥華。
How many Francophones are there?
法裔人口大約多少？
About seven million speak French as their first language; most live in Quebec.
約 700 萬以法語為第一語言，多數住魁北克。
Which province has French as its only official language?
哪個省以法文為唯一官方語言？
Quebec.
魁北克。
Who are the Acadians?
Acadians 是指什麼人？
Descendants of French colonists who began settling in the Maritimes in 1604.
1604 年起在濱海省份定居的法國殖民者後代。
Who are Quebecers?
Quebecers 是指什麼人？
The people of Quebec, the vast majority French-speaking.
魁北克的居民，絕大多數說法語。
What were residential schools?
「Residential Schools」是什麼？
Schools where the federal government placed Aboriginal children to assimilate them; languages and culture were mostly prohibited and many students suffered.
聯邦政府強制原住民兒童入住、禁止母語與傳統文化、以同化為目的的學校，許多學生受苦。
When did the government apologize for residential schools, and who spoke?
加拿大政府哪一年正式為寄宿學校道歉？由誰代表？
2008; Prime Minister Stephen Harper.
2008 年；總理史蒂芬・哈珀。
Do most Canadians live in cities or rural areas?
80% 的加拿大人住城市還是鄉村？
Cities — the majority live in urban areas.
城市。
When were treaties with Aboriginal peoples first guaranteed?
與原住民簽訂條約最早從哪一年開始？
The Royal Proclamation of 1763 established the basis for negotiating treaties.
1763 年《皇家公告》奠定了條約談判的基礎。
Does Canada respect religious freedom?
加拿大尊重宗教自由嗎？
Yes — freedom of conscience and religion is a fundamental freedom.
是——良知與宗教自由是基本自由。

title_zh: 第 3 部分 — 歷史（45 題）
qa: Which language does the word 'Canada' come from, and what does it mean?
「Canada」一詞來自哪族語言？意思？
Iroquoian — kanata means 'village'.
易洛魁語——kanata 意為「村莊」。
Who were the first Europeans to reach North America, where, and when?
第一批抵達北美的歐洲人是哪族？地點？年代？
The Vikings; L'Anse aux Meadows, Newfoundland; about 1,000 years ago.
維京人；紐芬蘭的蘭塞奧茲牧草地；約一千年前。
Which Italian explorer sailing for England mapped Canada's East Coast in 1497?
1497 探勘加拿大東岸的義裔英國探險家？
John Cabot.
約翰・卡伯特。
Which Frenchman explored the Gulf of St. Lawrence in 1534–35?
1534/1535 探勘 St. Lawrence Gulf 的法國人？
Jacques Cartier.
雅克・卡蒂亞。
Who founded Quebec City in 1608, and what is he called?
1608 建立 Quebec City 者？被稱什麼？
Samuel de Champlain; the Father of New France.
薩繆爾・德・尚普蘭；新法蘭西之父。
Which great trading company was chartered in 1670, and by which king?
1670 成立的最大殖民貿易公司？由哪位英王授權？
The Hudson's Bay Company; King Charles II.
哈德遜灣公司；英王查理二世。
What was the Hudson's Bay Company's territory called?
哈德遜灣公司的領地稱為？
Rupert's Land.
魯珀特地。
What was the battle of 1759, and where?
1759 戰役名稱與地點？
The Battle of the Plains of Abraham, outside Quebec City.
亞伯拉罕平原戰役，魁北克市城外。
Who were the two commanders in 1759, and what was the result?
1759 英法兩將軍是誰？結果？
Wolfe (British) and Montcalm (French); both were killed and the British won.
沃爾夫（英）與蒙卡姆（法）；雙雙陣亡，英軍勝。
By which treaty did France cede Canada in 1763?
1763 法國割讓加拿大的條約？
The Treaty of Paris, 1763.
1763 年《巴黎條約》。
Which three rights did the Quebec Act of 1774 preserve for French Canadians?
1774《Quebec Act》保留法裔哪三項權利？
Religious freedom for Catholics, the right to hold public office, and French civil law.
天主教信仰自由、擔任公職的權利、法國民法。
What were the British loyalists who fled north in 1775–83 called?
1775–83 北逃加拿大的英裔保皇黨稱？
Loyalists, or United Empire Loyalists.
效忠派／聯合帝國效忠派。
Roughly how many Loyalists fled to Canada?
Loyalists 大致逃了多少人？
More than 40,000.
超過四萬人。
Which country did Canada fight in the War of 1812?
1812 戰爭加拿大對抗哪國？
The United States.
美國。
Who was the 'Saviour of Upper Canada' in 1812?
1812「Saviour of Upper Canada」是誰？
Major-General Sir Isaac Brock.
少將艾薩克・布洛克爵士。
Which First Nations chief allied with the British in 1812?
1812 與英軍結盟的原住民首領是？
Chief Tecumseh.
酋長特庫姆塞。
What did Laura Secord do?
Laura Secord 做了什麼事？
She walked 30 km to warn the British of an American attack, helping win the Battle of Beaver Dams.
步行 30 公里向英軍通報美軍進攻，促成比佛丹戰役勝利。
Which city did the Americans burn in 1813, and what is it called today?
1813 美軍焚毀的城市？今天叫什麼？
York; today Toronto.
約克；今天的多倫多。
Which building did the British burn in 1814?
1814 英軍焚毀的建築是？
The White House in Washington, D.C.
華盛頓特區的白宮。
What did the British Empire do in 1833–34?
1834 大英帝國通過什麼？
It abolished slavery throughout the Empire (1833).
全帝國廢除奴隸制度（1833 年）。
What was the Underground Railroad?
Underground Railroad 是什麼？
A Christian anti-slavery network that helped American slaves escape to Canada.
協助美國黑奴秘密逃往加拿大的基督教反奴隸網絡。
Who were the two rebel leaders of 1837–38?
1837–38 兩位叛亂領袖？
William Lyon Mackenzie (Upper Canada) and Louis-Joseph Papineau (Lower Canada).
威廉・萊昂・麥肯齊（上加拿大）與路易－約瑟夫・帕皮諾（下加拿大）。
Which Act united Upper and Lower Canada in 1840?
1840 統一上下加拿大的法案？
The Act of Union, 1840.
1840 年《聯合法案》。
Which pair achieved responsible government in 1848–49?
1848/49 達成責任政府的雙人組？
Robert Baldwin and Louis-Hippolyte La Fontaine.
羅伯特・鮑德溫與路易－伊波利特・拉方丹。
Which law created Confederation on July 1, 1867?
1867/7/1 邦聯誕生的法律文件名稱？
The British North America Act, 1867.
1867 年《英屬北美法案》。
Which four provinces formed Canada in 1867?
1867 建國 4 個省？
Ontario, Quebec, Nova Scotia and New Brunswick.
安大略、魁北克、新斯科細亞、新布藍瑞克。
Who was Canada's first prime minister?
加拿大首任總理？
Sir John A. Macdonald.
約翰・A・麥克唐納爵士。
Where does the word 'Dominion' come from?
Dominion 字源出自聖經？
Psalm 72:8 — 'dominion from sea to sea'.
《詩篇》72 篇 8 節——「從這海直到那海」。
What is Canada's motto in Chinese?
國徽箴言中文？
A mari usque ad mare — from sea to sea.
從海到海。
When did Manitoba and the Northwest Territories join?
Manitoba 與 NWT 加入年份？
When did British Columbia join?
BC 加入年份？
When did Prince Edward Island join?
PEI 加入年份？
When was Yukon Territory created?
Yukon 加入年份？
When did Alberta and Saskatchewan join?
Alberta、Saskatchewan 加入年份？
When did Newfoundland and Labrador join?
Newfoundland and Labrador 加入年份？
When was Nunavut created?
Nunavut 成立年份？
When was the Canadian Pacific Railway completed?
CPR 完工年份？
How many Chinese workers built the CPR, and when and by whom was the apology made?
CPR 多少華工參與？哪一年道歉？哪位總理？
About 15,000; the apology for the Head Tax came in 2006 from Prime Minister Stephen Harper.
約 15,000 人；2006 年由總理史蒂芬・哈珀為人頭稅道歉。
When were Louis Riel's two uprisings, and what happened to him?
Métis 領袖 Louis Riel 兩次抵抗年份？最終下場？
Red River 1869–70 and the North-West Rebellion 1885; he was hanged for high treason.
1869–70 紅河；1885 西北叛亂；以叛國罪處絞。
Which province first gave women the provincial vote, in 1916?
1916 首個給予婦女省級投票權的省？
Manitoba.
曼尼托巴。
Who was the first woman MP, in 1921?
1921 首位女性 MP？
Agnes Macphail.
艾格妮絲・麥克費爾。
What was the 1929 case that recognized women as 'persons'?
1929 婦女被法律承認為「人」的案件名稱？
The Persons Case, won by the Famous Five.
「人格案」（Persons Case），由 Famous Five 打贏。
How many Canadians served and died in the First World War?
WWI 加拿大服役/陣亡人數？
More than 600,000 served; 60,000 were killed.
超過 60 萬人服役；6 萬人陣亡。
Which 1917 battle is seen as the birth of Canadian national identity?
1917 加拿大民族認同誕生的戰役？
Vimy Ridge.
維米嶺。
When did Canada declare war on Germany, how many died, and which D-Day beach did Canadians take?
WWII 加拿大何時對德宣戰？陣亡人數約？D-Day 加軍負責灘頭？
September 1939; about 44,000 killed; Juno Beach.
1939 年 9 月；約 44,000 人陣亡；朱諾海灘。
